title: Macedonian — BGN/PCGN 2013
authority: US Board on Geographic Names and UK Permanent Committee on Geographical Names, 2013 Agreement (checked for validity November 2023); replaces the BGN/PCGN 1981 agreement
description: Geographic-names romanization following the Macedonian Latin orthography: Ѓ→ǵ, Ж→ž, Ѕ→dz, Ќ→ḱ, Ч→č, Џ→dž, Ш→š, Љ→lj, Њ→nj. Also the Macedonian Academy (1970) and ALA-LC values.
notes: dz, lj, nj and dž are written as two letters; the agreement allows the digraph code points ǳ/ǉ/ǌ/ǆ (U+01F3/01C9/01CC/01C6) or individual letters.
The modifier apostrophe ʼ (U+02BC) before syllabic р is romanized ’ (U+2019): ʼРжаново → ’Ržanovo.
The BGN/PCGN 1981 agreement (and the UN system) used g/k before е, и and đ/ć elsewhere for Ѓ/Ќ; not encoded here.
Accented ѐ/ѝ are not in the table; mapped to e/i.
